baslik: Two Ships Watching Each Other on Radar Still Collided

kaynaklar.wikimedia: MS Stockholm bow damage after collision with SS Andrea Doria.jpg

sahneler.metin: In thick fog, the liner Stockholm rammed the Andrea Doria.
The Doria began listing, and forty six people aboard her were killed.
Both crews had been watching each other on radar.
They misjudged the plots and turned toward each other.
The list was so steep that half the lifeboats couldn't be launched.
Nearby ships rushed in and rescued most people.
The Doria sank the next morning.
Radar training and collision rules at sea were improved.

aciklama:
